caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented, rectangular piece of lace fabric rendered in grayscale. The lace features a repeating pattern of stylized floral motifs, with large, intricately detailed flowers and elongated leaves connected by slender, curving stems. The flowers and leaves are distributed across the lace in horizontal bands, with three bands of flowers and leaves that become denser toward the bottom, ending in a scalloped edge with additional floral detailing. The background of the lace has a fine, net-like texture, contrasting with the more opaque and detailed white outlines of the floral and leaf patterns. The left and right edges of the lace are straight, while the bottom edge is scalloped to mirror the floral designs. The composition is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding the lace, and a faint shadow effect is visible around the lace, adding a sense of depth to the illustration.
title: Lace Detail
